title: Detect Fan-Out Attacks in Timestamped Logs
prompt:
Connection logs are available as a sequence of `(timestamp, source_ip, destination_ip)` tuples. Timestamps are integer seconds in nondecreasing order; IPs are strings. Multiple events may have the same timestamp.

Implement `detect_fanout(events, window_seconds=600, max_destinations=10)`. For each event at time `t`, consider events from that source IP in the interval `(t - window_seconds, t]`, including the current event and only events processed so far. Emit `(t, source_ip)` if this window contains more than `max_destinations` distinct destination IPs. Repeated connections to the same destination count once. Return alerts in event order; emit an alert for every qualifying event, even when the source already triggered an earlier alert.

`window_seconds` is a positive integer and `max_destinations` is a non-negative integer. An empty input returns an empty list. Avoid rescanning all earlier events for each new event, and do not modify the input.
